story.title: The Russian Legend of the Forest Shape

sentences.text: If a heavy shadow follows you at night in the deep taiga... don't look back.
The old tales say some solitary travellers can shed their human skin.
Footprints in the snow start as heavy boots, then turn into massive claws.
Villagers bolted their wooden doors when the freezing wind brought low growls.
Something huge padded silently around the darkened houses, searching.
A sudden scream cut through the midnight air as the beast struck.
Only a dropped lantern and dark stains remained upon the bloodied path.
Would you turn around if you heard heavy footsteps behind you?
